summary: Stop dev deploy from failing on oversized paper fleet readyz line by emitting a bounded summary line in verify_dev_paper_fleet, filtering ended sessions in /readyz, and capping persisted ended monitoring sessions.
scope: scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh: verify_dev_paper_fleet emits bounded summary line with ready/live/worker_count/running_count/errors instead of raw full readyz payload
services/paper_fleet_reconciler/paper_fleet_reconciler.py: /readyz returns only active monitoring sessions with ended count, and persisted state caps ended sessions to 20
scripts/test_deploy_nonprod_vm.py: tests that summary line stays small (<512 bytes) for 100 workers and on failure
services/paper_fleet_reconciler/test_paper_fleet_reconciler.py: tests /readyz with 69 ended and 17 running sessions returns only 17 running sessions and caps persisted state

acceptance_criteria.ac1: verify_dev_paper_fleet prints a bounded summary of reconciler readiness (ready, live, worker_count, running_count, last_error, monitoring_last_error) instead of full readyz payload
acceptance_criteria.ac2: Paper fleet reconciler /readyz reports only active monitoring sessions; ended sessions are summarized by count
acceptance_criteria.ac3: Ended monitoring sessions are capped to 20 in persisted state so they do not accumulate without bound
acceptance_criteria.ac4: Tests assert summary line stays small (<512 bytes) for 100 workers and /readyz with 69 ended and 17 running sessions returns only the 17 running ones
acceptance_criteria.ac5: Evidence records hosted failure (deploy run 37727955933, DEV_ARTIFACT_OPERATION_FAILED at dev_remote_guarded_exec.py:143 stdout line exceeds bound) and before/after sizes
acceptance_criteria.ac6: No compressed code used to meet the line budget (clean PEP 8 and POSIX bash, net production line change: +30 lines <= 40)
acceptance_criteria.ac7: Hosted track recorded as external_wait pending the next automatic dev pair release
